reasons.text: The label photo is legible and shows model B0726Y, a recalled model, so the model is confirmed.
The date code 8/21 is within the recalled range (August 2021 or earlier).

The purchase date of 2017-11-08 is inside the sale window, but the retailer Corner Hardware Co is not on the list of sellers. Owners who bought from a store not on the list are asked for proof of ownership rather than denied.
The destruction photo does not clearly show the helmet with its straps cut off, which is the instructed destruction. A photo that does not show the instructed destruction is asked for again.
No duplicate claims were found, so the claim is not flagged.

input.question_for_claimant: Thank you for your claim. To continue, please send: (1) proof of ownership for this helmet, such as a receipt, order confirmation, or other document showing where and when you bought it, since Corner Hardware Co is not one of the listed retailers (Fred Meyer, Walmart, or www.Amazon.com); and (2) a new destruction photo showing the helmet with both straps cut off, as instructed.
